races.paceDynamic: Lady Kara is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the start, likely setting an uncontested lead with her sustainable style. After The Ball, Yeld To Call, Miss Denver and Mega Etoile will track prominently behind, while the majority of the field including Hornica, Merely A Detail, Bonnet's Secret and Lilycala prefer to come from off the pace. With minimal early pressure on Lady Kara, the pace will be steady rather than demanding, allowing her to conserve energy for the finish. This undemanding gallop strongly favours prominent runners and the leader, as hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground against runners who've conserved energy in forward positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lady Kara Dictates Terms
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Kara gets an easy lead and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The mare faces minimal early pressure and uses her tactical advantage to build a winning margin, with prominent trackers unable to match her sprint having sat closer to the pace. Her consistent record on good going and front-running style perfectly suits this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners times their challenge perfectly to catch Lady Kara late
scenarios.body: After The Ball or Yeld To Call benefit from tracking the leader's steady gallop and have enough left to reel her in during the final furlong. The even pace plays into their hands as they avoid the energy-sapping task of making up significant ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes slower than expected and Lady Kara kicks too late
scenarios.body: Merely A Detail or Hornica get the perfect setup with a dawdling gallop that allows them to unleash a devastating late charge. Their class advantage tells when they get the right race shape to display their finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Lilycala or Willow Edge possess untapped ability on their hurdling debuts
scenarios.body: The lightly raced newcomers benefit from the steady gallop and their fresh legs prove decisive against more exposed rivals. Their unknown quantities could spring a shock if they adapt quickly to hurdling.

watchPoints.text: Lady Kara's early fractions will determine the entire race outcome - if she gets soft sectionals she becomes extremely dangerous
After The Ball and Yeld To Call need to position prominently early or risk getting caught behind the slow pace
Merely A Detail requires a genuine pace collapse to be effective from her hold-up position
The lightly raced Lilycala and Willow Edge are complete unknowns over hurdles and could outrun their odds
Hornica needs others to pressure Lady Kara early to create the strong gallop her running style demands

races.paceDynamic: Juggernaut and Seahouses will likely share pace-making duties early, with Getaway With You also positioned prominently. The moderate gallop should suit the large hold-up contingent of Floating Rock, East Eagle, Scudamore, The Last Drop, Kampari, The Kings Soldier, and Jewel Eyed Judy. With only 2-3 horses wanting to be handy against 7 confirmed hold-up horses, this race sets up perfectly for closers who can time their challenge in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady as expected with Juggernaut and Seahouses content to bowl along.
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses will have plenty of room to maneuver and can time their challenges perfectly. East Eagle, Scudamore, and Kampari all have the class to capitalize on this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Juggernaut kicks on approaching two out and the hold-up horses fail to respond quickly enough.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the pace-setters to dictate throughout and they prove hard to peg back. Juggernaut's recent solid form and Seahouses' course versatility become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a real slog in testing ground conditions despite the good going description.
scenarios.body: The stamina-laden hold-up horses benefit from a truly-run race that plays to their strengths. Floating Rock's experience and Scudamore's proven ability at this trip come to the fore.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both Juggernaut and Seahouses go too slowly early and the race becomes a sprint from the last.
scenarios.body: No horse gets into a proper rhythm and the race becomes a lottery decided by position and luck rather than merit. Any horse could win from this muddling scenario.

watchPoints.text: Juggernaut could get an uncontested lead and prove difficult to peg back if allowed his own way in front
East Eagle has winning form and the perfect hold-up style to exploit the likely pace scenario
Scudamore drops back to a more suitable trip after his recent effort over longer and has the class to win
Floating Rock returns after a long absence but his hold-up style suits this race setup perfectly
The weight distribution heavily favors the hold-up horses with 7lb claims on several key contenders

races.paceDynamic: Miss Maverick, Max Of Stars, Borna Gem and Mary provide four confirmed front-runners in an 11-runner field, guaranteeing a fierce early gallop over this stamina-testing 2m4½f trip. The pace will be strong throughout with multiple leaders vying for position, creating a searching test that will stretch the field and expose any stamina limitations. This sustained gallop will fragment the field early and heavily favour hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and finish strongly when others tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners engage in early pace warfare and burn each other out
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop sets up perfectly for closers who can pick off tired leaders in the final half-mile. Patient riders on proven stayers will benefit most from the collapse ahead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners can secure the perfect stalking position behind the battling leaders
scenarios.body: D Day Arvalenreeva or Jaminska track the pace without getting embroiled in early speed duels. They inherit the race when front-runners weaken but before hold-up horses can mount their challenge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter can establish clear advantage and dictate more manageable fractions
scenarios.body: Max Of Stars or Mary break clear early enough to control the tempo and see off late challengers. The class advantage of setting their own pace proves decisive despite the strong early gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early speed battle is so fierce that no front-runner survives the opening mile
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete staying test with only the strongest finishers involved at the business end. Ultra-patient tactics and proven stamina become paramount over any pace advantage.

watchPoints.text: Miss Maverick confirmed non-runner removes one key pace angle and reduces early speed pressure
Max Of Stars and Mary both return from long layoffs as front-runners - watch for market confidence or drift

races.paceDynamic: Felton Bellevue will set a sustainable pace from the front with minimal early pressure, as the field is dominated by hold-up horses. Chief Black Robe, Pescatorius, Unspeakable, Carpe Diem and Yes And Yes all prefer to be held up, creating a tactical waiting game behind the leader. Illogical Logic may track Felton Bellevue in second early but won't apply serious pressure. This shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as they'll get the perfect tempo to unleash their kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Felton Bellevue sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays steady
scenarios.body: The five hold-up horses get ideal conditions to produce their finishing kicks with Unspeakable and Carpe Diem best placed to capitalize on their class edge. Chief Black Robe's proven stamina at this trip makes him dangerous despite his age.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If Felton Bellevue goes too slow and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test over the final half-mile where Unspeakable's superior TopSpeed rating of 92 becomes decisive. Carpe Diem and Illogical Logic can also quicken but may lack Unspeakable's raw pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Felton Bellevue gets easy fractions and the hold-up horses fail to organize
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old veteran uses his experience and gets first run on his rivals who leave their challenges too late. His recent second at Warwick on soft ground shows he retains enough ability when conditions suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly run throughout the extended trip
scenarios.body: Chief Black Robe's proven stamina at 3m+ distances and his 10-year-old's experience of grinding out tough finishes becomes the deciding factor. The younger horses may not handle the sustained galloping test.

watchPoints.text: Unspeakable needs to show full fitness after 136 days off despite his clear class edge on ratings
Felton Bellevue's new headgear combination of tongue-tie and blinkers could either sharpen him up or unsettle his jumping
Chief Black Robe must prove his stamina reserves remain intact at age 10 after two below-par efforts
Carpe Diem's visor first time suggests connections expect improvement and his hold-up style suits this race shape
Amateur jockey Murphy-Knight on Illogical Logic may struggle with tactical timing in a race that will require precise positioning

This creates a solid pace scenario without being overly strong, as Three Pikes shouldn't be pressured early given the lack of other confirmed front-runners. The moderate gallop will allow the prominent racers to stay competitive throughout, while the hold-up horses like Jet Of Dreams, Chicago Storm and Ufouria will need things to fall right from the back. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers who can sit handy and kick from the front group.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Three Pikes sets a steady tempo without early pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent racers tracking behind can stay competitive throughout and have first run on the leaders approaching the final flight. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from too far back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Three Pikes gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Three Pikes to dictate terms and prove too strong when asked for effort. Prominent racers can't peg back the leader's advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes surprisingly strong with prominent racers pressuring Three Pikes
scenarios.body: This creates a more genuine gallop that sets up perfectly for the hold-up horses to come from the back with a strong finish. The early pace merchants tire in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: D

watchPoints.text: Three Pikes must be monitored closely early as the only confirmed leader - if pressured or racing keenly the whole complexion changes

Chicago Storm with the 5lb claim could be value if getting a strong pace from the back
Jet Of Dreams returning after 160 days needs to show early sharpness to get competitive position

races.paceDynamic: Bond Broker will dictate terms from the front with no other confirmed leaders to pressure him early. Park Annonciade and Mister Cessna will track prominently but neither has the natural pace to hassle Bond Broker through the first circuit. The Paul Nicholls runner can string them out at a tempo that suits, with Pure Carbon forced to come from further back on his hold-up style. This sets up perfectly for prominent runners who can stay in touch without working hard early, then pounce when Bond Broker's sustained galloping begins to tell.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running Success
scenarios.trigger: If Bond Broker maintains his jumping rhythm and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The experienced front runner can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to peg back up the straight. His recent Cheltenham second shows he handles this type of tactical scenario well.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Park Annonciade or Mister Cessna can stay handy without working hard
scenarios.body: They get the perfect tow into the race before challenging the tiring leader in the final half-mile. Both have recent winning form and suit this patient prominent approach.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing and the leaders tire significantly
scenarios.body: Pure Carbon's stamina kicks in during a strong-run finish where his closing style proves decisive. His recent third at this trip suggests he's building fitness.

scenarios.label: D

Pure Carbon's positioning early - if he's closer than usual it suggests connections expect a stronger pace

races.paceDynamic: Largy Pearl will lead from the start with no genuine pace pressure in this small field, likely controlling fractions throughout the 2m6½f trip. Kansas Du Berlais and Killer Clown will sit prominently but neither is aggressive enough to force a genuine gallop early. The lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a tactical affair with runners still in contention turning for home. This setup heavily favours front-runners and prominent racers who can control their own destiny, while hold-up horses Important Notice and Amidnightstar face a significant disadvantage without a strong early pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Largy Pearl Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Largy Pearl maintains an uncontested lead without serious challenge until the home straight
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time of it and has enough left to resist late challenges, making full use of the tactical advantage. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground without a strong pace to close into.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duo Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Kansas Du Berlais and Killer Clown close on Largy Pearl approaching the final three fences
scenarios.body: The race becomes a battle between the three prominent runners with superior class and fitness telling. Killer Clown's recent form and higher rating gives him the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is even slower than expected and Important Notice gets a perfect late run
scenarios.body: The lack of early speed allows the hold-up runner to conserve energy and produce a sustained challenge, capitalizing on superior recent form. Amidnightstar could also benefit from similar tactics.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If Largy Pearl stops quickly after a long time off and the race becomes a sprint from the last

Important Notice and Amidnightstar both need a strong gallop to be effective but may not get it in this small field
Killer Clown's recent winning form makes him dangerous if getting into contention approaching the last two fences
